reason: Reviewed PC-only UI, live-adjust, preview, explicit episode snapshot delivery and opt-in ROS episode receiver changes. Added read-only visual inspection of all stations with CAD/material comparisons, ROI/rotation seating checks, required complete exterior at the finished pallet, and shared linear-center markers in both camera tabs. User-confirmed empty-pallet image registration and visible-rim tracking are inspection-only; they never update motor/teaching coordinates or gate execution. Pi protocol, actuator commands and controller code are unchanged. Carrier insert regions now follow their own CAD silhouettes with a 2 mm center tolerance; housing body masks reject low-saturation floor noise and template ranking accounts for alignment offsets. These are PC-only inspection changes. Shallow cavity edge evidence distinguishes same-colored carrier caps/housings. Moved finished pallets can reacquire upper/lower white edges when reference tracking fails; reacquisition remains inspection-only. Insert containment and center checks now use full CAD body vertices (including sides) rather than top-only features; ambiguous candidate wording is replaced with explicit inspection-unavailable status. Pi episode libraries are read at startup with local draft preservation; implicit episode uploads are removed. Separate step editing and episode notification/settings tabs, explicit validated settings export, display-only camera outline interpolation, and read-only dual-arm monitoring were reviewed. Motion RPCs and device-control code are unchanged. Camera-only startup blocks motor/leader/calibration actions and session restoration. Pending startup callbacks are cancelled at close. PC profile switching clears obsolete trim offsets when installing three-point calibration. Compact teaching/monitor layouts and held-detection labels are corrected; no Pi motion or detection code changed. Camera-only arm selection connects the selected Pi camera without opening local USB or the linear monitor. Opt-in product and visual inspection checkpoints split PC and Pi CLI targets at inspection steps. Shared policy, criteria assets and validators are synchronized; tick RPC formats and motor drivers are unchanged. Inspection failure blocks subsequent targets and normal completion. Camera-only mode remains motor-disabled. Protocol 3: retreat-step completion starts concurrent visual checks on PC and Pi, failure requests HOLD, final DONE waits for all checks. Startup checks follow jig acquisition; fixed-station checks overlap linear travel. Shared inspection policy/runtime and Pi CLI are synchronized; motor driver and RPC formats are unchanged. PC UI consistency: matched native input/button typography and height, camera toolbar alignment, and shared 3D preview in episode adjustment. No Pi execution changes in this UI update. Fixed-height camera inspection text prevents viewport jumps; previous detection outlines remain display-only for up to five seconds while processing, invalidated by new results/video loss. Monitor columns fit both maximized cards with conditional horizontal scrolling. Jig overview display refresh is limited to 1 Hz except errors/video loss; short adoption labels retain full selected-row details. Measurement and inspection timing are unchanged. Protocol 4: startup targets are inspected in one shared-frame batch with per-target minimum valid observations, missing results excluded, completed targets removed, timeout preserved. Shared Pi criteria synchronized. Work monitor resolves internal IDs to registered names. Carrier visual tolerance synchronized on PC/Pi: full CAD insert silhouette and center allowance 3 mm, carrier edge fringe 1 percent, detailed failure positions and separate terminal FAILED summary. Assembly criteria and motion control unchanged. PC/Pi plan RPC validates per-step inspection fields separately from temporary geometry episode; full episode product validation remains enforced on save/load/execute. No motion commands changed. PC partial step execution scopes completion markers to the selected steps; PC linear step inspections query current controller target. Both PC export and Pi receiver reject inspection schedules without a following retreat before writing. Pi execution settings and episodes are unchanged. PC/Pi finished empty-pallet templates use low-contrast white edges, 45 percent shape/score floor, stronger 10 percent state separation and 98 percent color-absence evidence. Occupied-product criteria unchanged. Unknown grouped-inspection timeout retains measured location and diagnostic scores. PC/Pi episode inspections retain the pre-execution confirmed jig poses. Inspection workers use fixed projected regions and never redetect, track or relocate jigs during execution. Startup preparation includes inspection-only jigs; PC camera detection is disabled while checks run. Motor and linear commands unchanged. All inspection stations now use 1 percent boundary fringe and 12 degree non-round rotation tolerance; insert center tolerance remains 3 mm. Wrong part, missing required parts and incomplete assembly criteria remain enforced. Terminal action result prints a single separator after completion/failure. Inspection failures explicitly name observed state and certain product alongside expected state. Work monitor prints pending event details before the current-state transition; movement ordering and inspection acceptance are unchanged. PC/Pi explicit cap-only incomplete templates and exposed-insert shape/centering validation reject the user-reproduced tilted insert and detached cap. Failed CLI jobs retain verified safe pose/context for explicit RESET after executor exit; Action control waits for actual safe-return and torque-off completion. No automatic reset or episode resume. Both PC and Pi now apply the existing cavity-edge evidence to assembly and finished stations, distinguishing same-colored housing and cap-only templates. Exact prior approved pair reconstructed with the backed-up shape_inspection.py; all other code unchanged. Shared source and inspection criteria match. PC-only inspection capture controls now save paired raw/display PNGs and diagnostic JSON. Display labels avoid projected part/fixture regions and other labels. vision.py changes affect annotate/annotate_all only; detection, motion, wire protocol, and shared inspection criteria are unchanged. Pi runtime is unchanged. PC camera inspection table has wider target labels, scrollable untruncated details, and explicitly marked display-only prior results during refresh for at most five seconds. Camera loss and context changes clear retained rows; episode inspection decisions and Pi code are unchanged. Corrected the PC-only render path: retain matching inspection regions individually during detector gaps, including fresh frames with no current detection. Do not drop cached result rows when adding display-only old outlines. UI tests exercise actual table update and verify old regions are never submitted to inspection workers. Actual running UI showed all retained rows becoming gray/waiting each cycle. Display-only retention now preserves the prior classification color and count; freshness is reported separately via display_retained and refresh status. The five-second expiration and all camera/context invalidation remain unchanged. PC-only UI inspection task identity no longer changes for each measured pose jitter/detection gap. Frames still use their current anchors; actual arm, calibration/profile, catalog, endpoint or linear-state changes reset the UI worker. Episode execution inspection is untouched. Actual Pi detection latency measured 1.66 s. PC preview now retains detection data up to existing MEASUREMENT_MAX_AGE_SECONDS=3 with original timestamp; only the inspection display uses that bound. Jig acceptance, camera preview freshness and episode decision thresholds remain unchanged. Live instrumentation measured UI classifier completion at 1.9-2.2 seconds. Completed UI results now use the same five-second display window rather than being discarded at 1.5 seconds; this does not change episode inspection policy. UI InspectionWorker confirmation now tolerates its actual processing interval instead of resetting after one second. The shared file was synchronized with Pi and criteria signatures verified; actual ShapeInspector classification and episode decision thresholds were not changed. The five-second UI result-retention clock starts when inspection finishes, not when its input frame was captured, so processing time does not consume the display interval. Original frame time remains in capture metadata. Linear fixture A/B product requirements are enforced; both candidates remain available and uncertain product identity cannot pass. Geometry and seating files synchronized with Pi and criteria verified. Carrier seating now allows A sphere 5 mm center/silhouette, B insert 4 mm silhouette with 3 mm center, and housing 2 mm boundary margin with 5 mm translation limit. Shared classifier synchronized and criteria verified. Carrier seating now allows A sphere 5 mm center/silhouette, B insert 6 mm silhouette with 3 mm center, and housing 2 mm boundary margin with 5 mm translation limit. Shared classifier synchronized and criteria verified. PC teaching layout widens the episode list at maximized size and adjusts policy and preview widths; startup table widths fit the narrower panel. No robot execution behavior changed. Restored six visible joint sliders in the PC step editor; existing tick callbacks unchanged. PC-only UI polish: overflow-only scrollbars, compact camera details and dual monitoring, grouped calibration/settings actions, shorter connection guidance. No inspection criteria or device command behavior changed. PC 16:9 preview and episode-adjustment delivery tab. SSH receiver supports identity-preserving episode library updates, revision checks, backups, optional settings and rollback; existing execution bindings remain. No automatic episode delivery performed. Inspection protocol 5 starts checks on the displayed step completion. Legacy episodes and linked completion events migrated one step forward with backups to preserve actual timing. Pi inspection core and targeted domain/CLI patches synchronized; PC preview aspect projection and arm-specific linear endpoint fixes are display-only. GUI full episodes reuse the Pi CLI with existing GUI leases; read-only execution_state RPC validates ownership without refreshing UI heartbeats. PC diagnostics optional-tab switch fixed. Pi runtime restarted after explicit user approval and clean app shutdown. Command priority: immediate safe-pose handoff, accepted-goal lock inheritance, final completion acknowledgement after cleanup, cancellable runtime idle torque release. PC safe shutdown: transmitted receiver reuses existing reset runner and borrowed GUI leases; confirms both arms stable for three seconds and OFF before disconnect. Independent B transport uses current visual seating without prior assembly history; only explicit build_load handoff uses the matching current-chain receipt. Shared inspection and CLI sources synchronized. Pi-owned detached shutdown transfers leases before GUI exit; completion follows resource release. Inspection decisions use current visual state only, with no prior-history prerequisite in standalone or chained jobs.
